mapper.select: SELECT WAREKY, COMPKY, NAME01, NAME02, NAME03 FROM WAHMA WHERE 1 = 1 AND DELMAK <> 'V'

SELECT PASSWD, NMLAST, NMFIRS, DEPART, PDAMKY, (SELECT ADDR05 FROM WAHMA WHERE WAREKY = #{OBJID}) AS OWNRKY, (SELECT NAME01 FROM WAHMA WHERE WAREKY = #{OBJID}) AS OWNRNM FROM USRMA WHERE 1 = 1 AND USERID = #{USERID}
SELECT WAREKY, AREATY, AREAKY, SHORTX FROM AREMA
SELECT WAREKY,LOCAKY, LOCATY,SHORTX, ZONEKY, AREAKY FROM LOCMA WHERE 1 = 1 AND WAREKY = #{OBJID}

SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy') AS SYSYEAR, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'mm') AS SYSMONTH, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'dd') AS SYSDAY, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'hh24') AS SYSHOUR, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'mi') AS SYSMINUTE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'ss') AS SYSSECOND FROM DUAL

SELECT PGMID, OBJTY, OBJID, OBJDFV, INDVIS, INDENB, INDDFC, TO_CHAR(INDWTH, 'FM999') AS INDWTH, INDORD, VPLTCR, VPLTDP FROM HHTMG WHERE 1 = CASE WHEN 0 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HHTMG WHERE OBJID LIKE #{OBJID} || '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AND OBJID LIKE #{OBJID} || '%' AND INDBZL = ' '
SELECT PGMID, OBJTY, OBJID, OBJDFV, INDVIS, INDENB, INDDFC, TO_CHAR(INDWTH, 'FM999') AS INDWTH, INDORD, VPLTCR, VPLTDP FROM HHTMG WHERE OBJID LIKE #{OBJID} || '%' AND INDBZL = ' '

SELECT LANGKY, LABLGR, LABLKY, LBLTXS, LBLTXM, LBLTXL FROM JLBLM WHERE 1 = CASE WHEN 0 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JLBLM WHERE LANGKY = #{LANGKY} AND LABLGR IN ('HHTBTN', 'HHTGRD', 'HHTSTD', 'HHTTITLE') AND LABLKY LIKE #{OBJID} || '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AND LANGKY = #{LANGKY} AND LABLGR IN ('HHTGRD', 'HHTSTD') AND LABLKY LIKE #{OBJID} || '%' AND INDBZL = ' '
SELECT LANGKY, LABLGR, LABLKY, LBLTXS, LBLTXM, LBLTXL FROM JLBLM WHERE LANGKY = #{LANGKY} AND LABLGR IN ('HHTBTN', 'HHTGRD', 'HHTSTD', 'HHTTITLE') AND LABLKY LIKE #{OBJID} || '%' AND INDBZL = ' '
SELECT LANGKY, MESGGR, MESGKY, MESGTX FROM JMSGM WHERE LANGKY = #{LANGKY} AND MESGGR LIKE 'HHT' || '%'
SELECT DOCUTY, DOCCAT, SHORTX, DOCGRP FROM DOCTM
SELECT OWNRKY, DOCCAT, DOCUTY, RSNCOD, SHORTX FROM RSNCD WHERE OWNRKY = #{OBJID} AND DOCUTY IN ('520')
SELECT CMCDKY,CMCDVL,CDESC1,CDESC2,USARG1,USARG2,USARG3,USARG4,USARG5 FROM CMCDV WHERE 1 = 1 AND CMCDKY IN ('SKUG01', 'LOTA05')
SELECT PROGID, CHCKID, SEQUNO, DBCOLN, APCOLN, CALPKG, PKGPMT, SQLKEY FROM MSIMA WHERE (PROGID = #{PROGID} OR PROGID = 'COMMON') AND CHCKID = #{CHCKID}
SELECT SQLSTA FROM JQMAP WHERE SQLKEY = #{SQLKEY}
